Stable shell, configurable domain modules

Question, inputs, evidence, decision, artifact, completion state.

03 · Agent handoff

Architecture brief

Model the product around a shared case object. CORE OBJECTS - Case - Stage - Input - Claim - Evidence - Judgment - Decision - Stakeholder - Risk - Artifact KEY RELATIONSHIPS - Case contains Stages. - Stage captures Inputs, Judgments, Evidence, and Decisions. - Evidence supports or challenges Claims. - Evidence may supersede an Estimate or Judgment. - Decision changes Case or Stage state. - Stakeholder owns a Decision or is affected by a Case. - Risk may block a Stage transition. - Artifact is generated from current case data and keeps links to source objects. - Carried values retain provenance to their source Stage and original object. SYSTEM RULES - History is append-only for meaningful judgments and decisions. - Supersession creates a new record and links to the old record. - Domain modules may add fields and labels but must not break the shared case grammar. - APIs, database schema, UI components, and AI orchestration should use the same object vocabulary.
